cues.en: So we have our config all set up, and we're ready to start chunking our data.
cues.zh: 設定都準備好了，可以開始將資料切成區塊。

cues.en: And why are we going to chunk this?
cues.zh: 為什麼要切塊？

cues.en: Well, if you think it through, let's say we had a 50-page document we wanted to ingest into our RAG store.
cues.zh: 仔細想想，假設有一份 50 頁的文件要匯入 RAG 儲存區，

cues.en: If we had one set of vectors or one entry in the vector store for that 50-page document, we're not going to get great search results because it'll kind of average all of the content in those 50 pages.
cues.zh: 如果整份 50 頁文件只對應一組向量，或向量儲存區裡只占一筆資料，搜尋結果就不會太好，因為它會把這 50 頁的內容概括在一起。

cues.en: And if we're looking for a specific thing, and it's in those 50 pages, we might not find it.
cues.zh: 若要找的特定資訊就在這 50 頁裡，可能反而找不到。

cues.en: So what we do instead is we embed many small chunks.
cues.zh: 所以我們改為對許多小區塊分別建立嵌入，

cues.en: We break that 50 pages up into, say, around 1,000 characters per chunk.
cues.zh: 將這 50 頁切成例如每個約 1000 字元的區塊。

cues.en: So the goal of chunking is to break a document into pieces that are small enough to embed well and will fit comfortably in the LLM's context window when several are put together.
cues.zh: 切塊的目標，是讓每塊足夠小，能產生好的嵌入，而且多塊放在一起也能輕鬆放進 LLM 的上下文視窗，

cues.en: They're large enough to carry standalone meaning.
cues.zh: 同時又夠大，能保有獨立的意義。

cues.en: For example, a sentence by itself is often too short.
cues.zh: 例如單獨一句話往往太短，

cues.en: We might have pronouns that reference previous sentences, things like that, and we have no idea what that one sentence actually means.
cues.zh: 裡面可能有指向前文的代名詞，導致我們不知道這句究竟在說什麼。

cues.en: So what we're going to do is take a large document and break it up into many smaller documents, ones that will work well with an LLM.
cues.zh: 因此要將大型文件切成許多較小的文件單位，讓它們能有效搭配 LLM。

cues.en: So let's get started.
cues.zh: 我們開始吧。

cues.en: I'm going to create a new file, and I'm going to put it in source.pyreg.
cues.zh: 我要在 src/pyrag 建立新檔案，

cues.en: I'll create a new file in there, and I'll call it chunking.py.
cues.zh: 命名為 chunking.py。

cues.en: And as I usually do, I'll do my imports first.
cues.zh: 照例先處理匯入。

cues.en: I'm going to use annotations, so from future import annotations.
cues.zh: 會用到 annotations，所以從 __future__ 匯入 annotations，

cues.en: We're going to need that for sure.
cues.zh: 這個一定需要。

cues.en: We're also going to use regular expressions, so we'll import our E right from Python standard library.
cues.zh: 也會使用正規表示式，因此匯入標準函式庫裡的 re。

cues.en: And we're going to use data classes, so from data classes we'll import data class.
cues.zh: 另外要使用資料類別，所以從 dataclasses 匯入 dataclass。

cues.en: And that should be all that we need for our imports, at least for right now.
cues.zh: 目前匯入這些應該就夠了，

cues.en: We might come back to this later on.
cues.zh: 之後可能會再回來修改。

cues.en: Now, let's set up a class, and let's make it a data class.
cues.zh: 現在建立類別，並讓它成為資料類別。

cues.en: So we'll use the annotation data class, and we'll set frozen equal to true.
cues.zh: 使用 @dataclass 裝飾器，設定 frozen=True，

cues.en: And we'll call this class chunk.
cues.zh: 類別叫做 Chunk。

cues.en: That seems like a reasonable name.
cues.zh: 這是很合理的名稱。

cues.en: And this chunk is going to be nothing more than a single chunk that we produce by calling some function.
cues.zh: Chunk 代表呼叫某個函式所產生的一個區塊，僅此而已。

cues.en: And we'll have two entries.
cues.zh: 它有兩個欄位。

cues.en: So the first one will be index.
cues.zh: 第一個是 index，

cues.en: Where does this exist? It's positioned within the source document.
cues.zh: 表示它在來源文件中的位置。

cues.en: That'll be an integer.
cues.zh: 型別是 int。

cues.en: And then we'll have the text that's in that chunk.
cues.zh: 接著是區塊裡的 text，

cues.en: And of course, that's just a string.
cues.zh: 當然就是 str。

cues.en: That's easy. So we have that.
cues.zh: 很簡單，這部分完成了。

cues.en: Now, when we break things up, we want to make it as logical as possible.
cues.zh: 切分時要盡量符合邏輯，

cues.en: So we'll try to watch for paragraph breaks.
cues.zh: 因此會辨識段落分界。

cues.en: So we'll set up a variable, and I'll call it paragraph underscore re for regular expressions.
cues.zh: 先建立變數 paragraph_re，re 代表正規表示式。

cues.en: And that's going to be equal to, by calling re, which we just imported, compile.
cues.zh: 它等於剛匯入的 re.compile 的結果，

cues.en: And we'll look for, with an r flag, slash n, slash s, and then a star, and then slash n.
cues.zh: 使用原始字串標記 r，內容為反斜線 n、反斜線 s、星號，再接反斜線 n。

cues.en: So a paragraph break is basically one or more blank lines.
cues.zh: 段落分界基本上就是一個或多個空白行，

cues.en: A new line, optional whitespace, then another new line.
cues.zh: 也就是換行、可有可無的空白，再另一個換行。

cues.en: And this is the same convention used in Markdown.
cues.zh: 這與 Markdown 使用的慣例相同，

cues.en: And it works just as well for plain text.
cues.zh: 純文字也一樣適用。

cues.en: So this allows us to look for paragraph breaks. That's all that's for.
cues.zh: 這個設定只是讓我們能找到段落分界。

cues.en: And then we'll define a function, and I'll call it underscore split underscore paragraphs.
cues.zh: 接著定義函式，命名為 _split_paragraphs，

cues.en: And that'll just take text, which we'll type into string.
cues.zh: 只接受 text，型別標註為 str，

cues.en: And it's going to return a list of strings.
cues.zh: 回傳字串串列。

cues.en: And this is dead simple.
cues.zh: 內容非常簡單，

cues.en: All this really does is split on blank lines and drop any empties.
cues.zh: 只要在空白行切分，並移除空項目，

cues.en: And we'll trim whitespace for every paragraph.
cues.zh: 再清除每段前後的空白。

cues.en: So we'll return in square brackets, and we'll have p dot strip, and we'll get p in a minute.
cues.zh: 因此回傳一個串列，裡面是 p.strip()；p 等一下就會定義。

cues.en: For p, there's our p, in underscore, paragraph underscore re for regular expression, dot split.
cues.zh: for p，就是這裡的 p，in _paragraph_re.split，

cues.en: And we're going to split text. If p, strip.
cues.zh: 把 text 拿來切分，後面再加 if p.strip()。

cues.en: And that's the whole function.
cues.zh: 整個函式就這樣。

cues.en: So all that does is split on blank lines and drop any empties.
cues.zh: 它只是依空白行切分，丟掉空白項目，

cues.en: And we trim the whitespace. Very simple.
cues.zh: 並清除前後空白，非常簡單。

cues.en: Then we'll define another function.
cues.zh: 接著再定義一個函式，

cues.en: And we'll call this one chunk underscore text.
cues.zh: 叫做 chunk_text。

cues.en: And this will take the text.
cues.zh: 它接收 text，

cues.en: That's a string.
cues.zh: 型別是 str；

cues.en: It'll take chunk size.
cues.zh: 也接收 chunk_size，

cues.en: How big are our chunks?
cues.zh: 也就是區塊有多大，

cues.en: That's an integer.
cues.zh: 型別是 int；

cues.en: And the overlap.
cues.zh: 還有 overlap，

cues.en: We want chunks to overlap a bit.
cues.zh: 因為希望區塊之間有部分重疊，

cues.en: Again, just an integer.
cues.zh: 同樣是 int。

cues.en: And this will return a list of chunks.
cues.zh: 回傳值是 Chunk 串列。

cues.en: Now, this is a slightly longer function.
cues.zh: 這個函式稍微長一些，

cues.en: But this is nothing more than paragraph-aware chunking with some kind of character window fallback.
cues.zh: 但也只是能辨識段落的切塊邏輯，必要時退回使用字元視窗。

cues.en: So the text, the first parameter, that's the raw document content.
cues.zh: 第一個參數 text 是原始文件內容。

cues.en: If that's a 50-page document, we want to break it up into chunks.
cues.zh: 如果那是一份 50 頁文件，我們就要切成區塊。

cues.en: Chunk size, the second parameter, that's the soft upper bound on chunk size in characters.
cues.zh: 第二個參數 chunk_size，是以字元計算的區塊大小軟性上限。

cues.en: And the overlap is how many characters to overlap between chunks.
cues.zh: overlap 則是區塊間重疊多少字元。

cues.en: And, of course, it's only used when a single paragraph is longer than chunk underscore size.
cues.zh: 當然，只有單一段落比 chunk_size 還長時才會用到。

cues.en: So, first of all, let's put a safety check in.
cues.zh: 首先加上安全檢查。

cues.en: So I'll say if overlap is greater than chunk size, well, of course, that shouldn't happen.
cues.zh: 如果 overlap 大於 chunk_size，這當然不應該發生，

cues.en: We'll raise an error.
cues.zh: 就拋出錯誤，

cues.en: We'll raise a value error.
cues.zh: 也就是 ValueError，

cues.en: And we'll pass overlap must be smaller than chunk size.
cues.zh: 並傳入「overlap must be smaller than chunk size」。

cues.en: You can't have an overlap that's bigger than chunk size. Very simple. Okay?
cues.zh: 重疊不能比區塊大小還大，非常簡單。

cues.en: So if we get past that, let's set chunks.
cues.zh: 通過檢查後，建立 chunks，

cues.en: And we'll type in that to a list of strings.
cues.zh: 型別標註為字串串列，

cues.en: And we'll make it equal to empty. Okay?
cues.zh: 初始值設為空串列。

cues.en: And then we'll have a variable called buff for buffer.
cues.zh: 再建立一個叫 buf 的變數，代表 buffer，

cues.en: This is the chunk we're currently going to be working on. Okay?
cues.zh: 也就是目前正在處理的區塊，

cues.en: So the chunk we're currently packing paragraphs into.
cues.zh: 用來逐段累積內容。

cues.en: Now, inside of this function, we'll define another function, def flush, which I have to spell right.
cues.zh: 在這個函式裡再定義一個函式 def flush，注意拼字。

cues.en: And it doesn't return anything.
cues.zh: 它不回傳內容，

cues.en: So all we're going to do in here is push the current buffer onto chunks and reset it. Okay?
cues.zh: 只把目前緩衝區加入 chunks，然後重設。

cues.en: So we'll use the keyword non-local, as you often do in Python, buff.
cues.zh: 使用 Python 常見的 nonlocal 關鍵字，指定 buf。

cues.en: And if buff.strip, we'll try getting rid of its whitespace.
cues.zh: 如果 buf.strip() 有內容，也就是去除前後空白後不為空，

cues.en: All we're going to do in here is say chunks.append buff.strip. Okay?
cues.zh: 就呼叫 chunks.append(buf.strip())。

cues.en: And then after that, not part of the if statement, we'll set buff back to zero or to an empty string. Okay?
cues.zh: 接著在 if 外面，將 buf 重設為空字串。

cues.en: And after that, outside of that function definition, but part of chunk text, we'll have a for loop for para in underscore split paragraphs.
cues.zh: 然後離開這個內部函式定義，但仍在 chunk_text 裡，建立 for 迴圈：for para in _split_paragraphs，

cues.en: That function we just defined for each paragraph in text. Okay?
cues.zh: 呼叫剛才定義的函式，逐段處理 text。

cues.en: That's our for loop.
cues.zh: 這就是我們的 for 迴圈。

cues.en: We have a couple of cases.
cues.zh: 有幾種情況要處理，

cues.en: The first one, the paragraph is too big.
cues.zh: 第一種是段落太大。

cues.en: So we're going to, and what it's typically called is, we're going to window it. Okay?
cues.zh: 這時要做通常所謂的視窗化切分，

cues.en: And it's very straightforward.
cues.zh: 非常直接。

cues.en: We'll first of all check for the case.
cues.zh: 先檢查這種情況，

cues.en: If the length of para, our current iteration through this for loop, if it's greater than chunk size, okay, then we, of course, we have to handle that.
cues.zh: 如果目前這輪迴圈的 para 長度大於 chunk_size，當然就要處理。

cues.en: So first, we'll flush whatever was already buffered. Okay?
cues.zh: 首先將已在緩衝區的內容輸出，

cues.en: So we just call flush, that function we defined right there on line 26. Okay?
cues.zh: 直接呼叫第 26 行定義的 flush。

cues.en: And then we'll set a variable start.
cues.zh: 接著建立 start 變數，

cues.en: We'll make that default to zero.
cues.zh: 初始值設為 0。

cues.en: And then we'll have a while loop.
cues.zh: 再建立 while 迴圈，

cues.en: While start is less than the length of the current paragraph, we're going to do something.
cues.zh: 只要 start 小於目前段落長度，就持續處理。

cues.en: And all we do is here, we have a start, so let's set the end.
cues.zh: 現在已經有 start，所以接著設定 end。

cues.en: End is going to be equal to, and this is simple math, we use the built-in function min, and we pass
cues.zh: end 的計算只是簡單數學，使用內建 min，傳入

cues.en: it start, which is currently zero on the first pass through, plus chunk size for the length of the current paragraph. Okay?
cues.zh: start 加上 chunk_size，以及目前段落長度；第一輪 start 是 0。

cues.en: So now we know what the end is going to be.
cues.zh: 這樣就知道 end 是多少。

cues.en: And we'll say chunks, chunks plural, dot append.
cues.zh: 接著對複數的 chunks 呼叫 append，

cues.en: We're going to append to that para, beginning at start, going to end, which we just calculated, and we'll get rid of any white space. Strip. Okay?
cues.zh: 加入 para 從 start 到剛算出的 end 的內容，並用 strip 清除前後空白。

cues.en: So we've done that.
cues.zh: 這樣就加入了。

cues.en: And then we just check to see if we're at the end.
cues.zh: 接著檢查是否已到結尾，

cues.en: If end is equal to the length of para.
cues.zh: 如果 end 等於 para 的長度，

cues.en: Well, what do we do in here? We break. We get out. We're finished. Okay?
cues.zh: 要做什麼？break，跳出，已經完成了。

cues.en: Otherwise, if we get past that if statement, we slide the window forward by chunk size minus overlap.
cues.zh: 否則通過這個 if 後，就將視窗向前移動 chunk_size 減 overlap。

cues.en: And this allows consecutive windows to overlap by however many characters is stored in the variable overlap.
cues.zh: 如此相鄰視窗就會重疊 overlap 指定的字元數。

cues.en: So it's just start is now equal to, try that again, is now equal to end minus overlap. Okay?
cues.zh: 也就是將 start 設為 end - overlap，重新輸入一下。

cues.en: So that's our first case.
cues.zh: 這就是第一種情況。

cues.en: And when we're finished with that while loop, make sure you're back at the correct indentation level, right at the beginning of the while loop.
cues.zh: while 迴圈結束後，確認回到正確縮排層級，與 while 開頭相同。

cues.en: We just continue.
cues.zh: 接著直接 continue，

cues.en: Go back to the beginning of this loop and continue.
cues.zh: 回到這個迴圈的起點繼續處理，

cues.en: If there's anything else to do, work on that.
cues.zh: 若還有其他內容，就繼續。

cues.en: So that's our first case.
cues.zh: 這是第一種情況。

cues.en: Our second case is the paragraph actually fits.
cues.zh: 第二種情況是段落本身放得下，

cues.en: So we just pack it into the current buffer. Okay?
cues.zh: 因此直接將它放進目前緩衝區。

cues.en: So we say if the length of buff plus the length of the paragraph, and then we add two. Okay?
cues.zh: 判斷 buf 的長度加上段落長度，再加 2。

cues.en: And why am I adding two?
cues.zh: 為什麼加 2？

cues.en: I'm adding two to account for the slash end slash end separator.
cues.zh: 因為要把反斜線 n、反斜線 n 這個分隔符算進去，

cues.en: So we insert between paragraphs when we're joining them together. Okay?
cues.zh: 合併段落時，會在段落之間插入它。

cues.en: That's the only reason that exists.
cues.zh: 存在這個加 2 的原因就是如此。

cues.en: If all of that is less than or equal to chunk size and then a colon, well, what do we do in here?
cues.zh: 如果總長度小於等於 chunk_size，就加上冒號，裡面要做什麼？

cues.en: It's very simple.
cues.zh: 很簡單，

cues.en: Buff is equal to, and we'll use a format string.
cues.zh: 將 buf 設為一段格式化字串，

cues.en: And in here we'll put buff, which I have to spell right, and then two blank lines. Okay?
cues.zh: 其中放入 buf，注意拼字，再加兩個換行字元，

cues.en: And then the paragraph.
cues.zh: 然後接上目前段落。

cues.en: And then one of the nice things we can do in Python is add an if statement right here.
cues.zh: Python 有個方便的寫法，可以直接在這裡加條件運算式，

cues.en: If buff else para. Okay?
cues.zh: if buf else para。

cues.en: And then we have an else statement. Else. The other case.
cues.zh: 然後還有 else，處理另一種情況。

cues.en: Adding this paragraph would overflow it, so start a fresh chunk.
cues.zh: 加入此段會超過上限，因此開始一個新區塊。

cues.en: We'll just flush.
cues.zh: 先 flush，

cues.en: Call that helpful method we built right up there on line 26.
cues.zh: 呼叫上面第 26 行寫好的便利方法，

cues.en: And buff is now equal to para. Okay?
cues.zh: 再將 buf 設為 para。

cues.en: Now, of course, when we're finished all of this, we need to go to the next line and give ourselves a blank line.
cues.zh: 所有這些操作完成後，換到下一行，留一個空白行，

cues.en: And then go back to the same level as the overall for loop.
cues.zh: 再回到與整個 for 迴圈相同的縮排層級，

cues.en: So it's not inside the for loop.
cues.zh: 也就是不在 for 裡面。

cues.en: We can't forget the final partial chunk. Okay?
cues.zh: 不能忘記最後那個不滿一個區塊的剩餘內容。

cues.en: We don't want to leave any of our document out. We'll flush.
cues.zh: 我們不能漏掉任何文件內容，所以再呼叫 flush。

cues.en: And then we return, in square brackets, chunk.
cues.zh: 然後回傳一個串列，裡面建立 Chunk，

cues.en: And then in parentheses, index equals i. Text equals t.
cues.zh: 括號中指定 index=i、text=t，

cues.en: And then outside of the parentheses, but inside the square brackets, for i, t, in enumerate chunks. If t. Okay?
cues.zh: 括號外、方括號內，接 for i, t in enumerate(chunks) if t。

cues.en: So, that should be our entire chunking logic.
cues.zh: 這樣應該就是完整的切塊邏輯了。

cues.en: So we can hand it a document of pretty much any size, anything that will fit comfortably into memory anyway.
cues.zh: 幾乎任何大小的文件都能交給它，只要能輕鬆放進記憶體，

cues.en: And we can break it up into chunks.
cues.zh: 就可以切成區塊。

cues.en: Now, chunking is a critical step, and we absolutely have to have it.
cues.zh: 切塊是非常重要而且必要的步驟，

cues.en: But, of course, we have to do something with those chunks.
cues.zh: 但當然還得對這些區塊做些事，

cues.en: We need to be able to put them in our vector store.
cues.zh: 需要將它們放進向量儲存區。

cues.en: Which means we need to create the embeddings that will be stored in our vector store.
cues.zh: 也就是要產生存放在向量儲存區的嵌入向量，

cues.en: Along with the actual chunk itself, so it's human readable, of course.
cues.zh: 並保留人類可讀的原始區塊內容。

cues.en: But we need to get started on embeddings.
cues.zh: 接下來該處理嵌入了，

cues.zh: 下一堂課就來做。
